items.source: A builder for points, so that coordinates and optionally a coordinate system can be configured. Dependening on the coordinate system, GeographicPoint2d or GeographicPoint3d will be created, cartesian points otherwise.
items.translation: 一个用于构建点的构造器，以便配置坐标和可选的坐标系。根据所选的坐标系，将创建 GeographicPoint2d 或 GeographicPoint3d，否则将创建笛卡尔坐标点。
